tags.name: AccessDomain
tags.description: APIs for managing administration areas (access domains) including CRUD operations and fetching details. Administration areas represent isolated management units within the system. In the simplest case, each client has one administration area. Multiple administration areas allow different security officers to manage the system independently, which is useful for multi-location deployments.

tags.name: AccessGrid
tags.description: APIs for managing access grids (room zones). Access grids define access areas by grouping components with the same rights. They control user access and are assigned to doors, lifts, and other entry points.

tags.name: AccessManager
tags.description: API's for managing access manager. Access manager is a hardware component responsible for controlling the access system entries.

tags.name: Alarm
tags.description: API for retrieving and configuring alarms.

tags.name: ApplicationDefinition
tags.description: APIs for retrieving application definitions for media configuration. These endpoints help determine which application definitions are available for a specific actuator technology and what media definitions belong together.

tags.name: Badge
tags.description: APIs for managing user media (badge, card). A badge is a medium assigned to a user for access control to the system. Media can include a physical card, chip, or mobile access.

tags.name: CardDefinition
tags.description: API's for managing card definitions. A card is a type of user medium that serves as a physical data carrier for access control. It is categorized under user media definitions based on its physical properties and functionality.

tags.name: CodeLock
tags.description: API's for managing the code locks. Code locks are access control components that secure user entry using a PIN.

tags.name: Command
tags.description: APIs for retrieving commands. Commands represent the available functions displayed to the user.

tags.name: Component
tags.description: API's for retrieving components. "Components" is a general term for any type of peripheral device.

tags.name: ControlProfile
tags.description: APIs for managing the control profiles. Control profiles are affecting the access of the passageways.

tags.name: Depot
tags.description: APIs for managing depots.

tags.name: DoorGroup
tags.description:
APIs for managing door groups. The door group is used to define the passage and time at which a user medium is authorized.
A door group combines CardLink or OSS-SO components with the same time zone.

tags.name: ExceptionalDay
tags.description: APIs exceptional days for managing exceptional days.

tags.name: Export
tags.description: APIs for managing exports.

tags.name: Graphic
tags.description:
API for managing the graphic application by providing resources that help the client
        have control over data points with proper visualization.

tags.name: Group
tags.description: APIs for managing groups. Groups determine user access to data from media, devices, persons, and profiles, as well as permissions for viewing or editing messages in dialogs, logbooks, and alarms.

tags.name: Logbook
tags.description: APIs for managing logbooks. Logbooks record all system events, classified and saved for easy tracing of access control activities. Users see only the data they are authorized to access by group in the access, time, error, display, download, system, audit, depot, parking, interface, media, and alarm logbooks.

tags.name: LoxTop
tags.description: APIs for managing loxtops. A LoxTop depot is represented by an access grid. A depot is, for example, a key copy, bunch of keys or a compartment for other items.

tags.name: MasterMedia
tags.description: APIs for managing master media. Master media are RFID media that are used to initialize, authorize and/or configure standalone components using the programmer. Master media are programmed system-specifically with the security card C. They are provided by dormakaba .

tags.name: ParkingPool
tags.description: APIs for managing parking pools. For each access profile, only one car park pool should be assigned. If several car park pools are assigned and one car park pool is occupied, the system does not recognise that the other car park pools are still free.

tags.name: PeripheryHierarchy
tags.description: APIs for retrieving periphery hierarchies.

tags.name: Person
tags.description: APIs for managing persons. Persons can be contractors, visitors or employees.

tags.name: ProfileCollection
tags.description: APIs for managing profile collections. A profile collection is the art of grouping multiple access profiles into a single profile.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: APIs for managing profiles. An access profile is defined if several people (employees, visitors or external company employees) are to be granted access to the same place and at the same time.

tags.name: RegistrationUnit
tags.description: APIs for managing registration units. Registration units are any type of reader that recognizes media.

tags.name: Root
tags.description: API health and availability checks.

tags.name: Site
tags.description: APIs for managing sites. A site is a physical or logical location where access control is applied.

tags.name: SysImport
tags.description: API's for managing system imports.

tags.name: TimeZone
tags.description: APIs for managing time zones. The time zone defines the times at which a user medium is authorized.

tags.name: ViewZone
tags.description: APIs for managing view zones. View Zones restrict visibility of certain elements (like doors, readers, access points, or organizational units) to specific users or roles.This ensures that administrators or operators only see the parts of the system relevant to their responsibilities.

tags.name: VisitHost
tags.description: API's for managing visits.

tags.name: PeripheryHierarchyV11
tags.description: APIs for retrieving periphery hierarchies.

tags.name: TimeZoneV11
tags.description: APIs for managing time zones. The time zone defines the times at which a user medium is authorized.

tags.name: SkyraAccessComponent
tags.description: APIs related to accessing skyra components such as eInserts. eInserts represent the skyra lock type component. By defining eInserts through commissioning process you can later associate them to an Access Point so those can be used to grant physical access through them.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: SkyraAccessPermission
tags.description: APIs for managing access point permissions within skyra.These permissions link access points to specific skyra user, defining the level of access and control each user has over the access points.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: SkyraAccessPoint
tags.description: APIs for managing access points in skyra.Access Points are representation of a passway in one direction through which one Access Area can be accessed in a controlled way by means of devices controlling access.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: SkyraAccessPointSecurityProfile
tags.description: APIs for managing access point security profiles in skyra.An access point security profile summarizes which access point security level is applied at which time at a given access point.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: SkyraEvent
tags.description: APIs for managing events in skyra.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: SkyraUser
tags.description: APIs for managing skyra users including retrieving EKey and updating user details. eKeys represent the skyra media type. By defining eKeys through commissioning process those can be associated with special types of Users who can be granted with physical access to Access Targets.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: SkyraUserInvitation
tags.description: APIs for managing skyra user invitations. skyra users represent the interactive user base of the API resources. Users can created via invitation sent to a user's recipient email address. Users can be assigned with predefined roles that defined their allowance over API resources. On the other hand, as well as for special types of users enable them with capabilities for being granted with physical access through API Access resources definition and assignment.To use this API's, the skyra license must be activated.

tags.name: OssSoAccessDomain
tags.description: APIs for managing administration areas (access domains) including CRUD operations and fetching details for OssSo. Administration areas represent isolated management units within the system. In the simplest case, each client has one administration area. Multiple administration areas allow different security officers to manage the system independently, which is useful for multi-location deployments.

tags.name: OssSoComponent
tags.description: API's for retrieving components for OssSo. "Components" is a general term for any type of peripheral device.

tags.name: OssSoDoorGroup
tags.description:
APIs for managing door groups for OssSo. The door group is used to define the passage and time at which a user medium is authorized.
A door group combines CardLink or OSS-SO components with the same time zone.

tags.name: OssSoMediaApplicationDefinition
tags.description: API's for managing media application definitions. For RFID media, a media definition corresponds to the transponder chip including the existing media applications.

tags.name: OssSoProfile
tags.description: APIs for managing profiles. An access profile is defined if several people (employees, visitors or external company employees) are to be granted access to the same place and at the same time.

tags.name: OssSoTimeZone
tags.description: APIs for managing time zones. The time zone defines the times at which a user medium is authorized.
